title: Choose Quilt's new look
question: Replacing the cream background, warm palette and fonts. The quilt idea, the spool, each app's own colour and the no-red rule stay. Keep the rolled direction, take another, or re-roll.

options.label: Letterman Patches
options.lineage: Varsity letter jackets: chenille patches sewn on with thick overlocked edges
options.thesis: Every app is a felt patch sewn onto your jacket, and confirming a change stitches it from patch to patch.
materials: flat felt patches with overlocked edges
ribbed knit hem with two stripes
options.viewport: Status line set in big tackle-twill numerals ($376 left), the waiting receipt as a safety-pinned dotted patch, the apps as felt patches, and the bar as a striped knit hem holding four pins. Light mode is heather-grey fleece; dark mode is navy wool.
options.risk: Can tip into costume or high-school nostalgia if the numerals and stripes appear everywhere; the felt has to stay flat.

raised.raise: Patches snap to a visible stitch grid, and every size is a whole number of grid cells.
One text size does most of the work; the tackle-twill numerals are the only display type.
Each app's felt colour works as a code, used the same way on its patch, its source dot, its thread and its pin.
All neutrals come from one heather ramp shared by the light and dark themes, and conflicts stay cross-hatched, never red.

options.label: Cross-stitch Chart
options.lineage: Counted cross-stitch charts and DMC floss cards
options.thesis: Each app is a floss colour with its own number; records are stitched squares on a chart grid.
options.viewport: Home as a chart: the status line over a grid of app squares, each in its floss colour with its number; waiting changes shown as un-stitched outlines; dark mode is black aida.
options.risk: The most expected reading of 'stitched', and the closest to the old quilt look; the grid can drift toward a spreadsheet.

options.label: Boarding Pass and Gate Board
options.lineage: Airline boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: Home is a departures board ranked by time, and every change holds its colour until you've seen it.
options.viewport: Next up as a gate board of dated items from every app, a changed row lit amber until seen, the receipt as a torn-off pass stub.
options.case: Strong on clarity because next-up ranking is the core of Home, but it loses the quilt and stitching identity you asked to keep.
options.risk: Reads like a travel app, so the per-app colours become secondary.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Numbers are built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.case: Students don't identify with Dutch type posters, and the grid fights the quilt.
options.kept: A visible grid that every patch size snaps to.

options.label: Software Manual Tab Board
options.thesis: Apps as coloured tab dividers down the edge.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail of apps beside one open section.
options.case: Loses both: unfamiliar to students and noisier than one Home screen.
options.kept: One text size doing most of the work.

options.label: Factory Records Catalog
options.lineage: Peter Saville sleeves and catalog numbers
options.thesis: Colour codes stand in for names.
options.viewport: A black field with one data plot.
options.case: It's the dark look you ruled out, and coded colour hides meaning.
options.kept: Each app's colour as a strict code used the same way everywhere.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Loses both: it reads as a type experiment, not a daily tool.
options.kept: One display face repeated at a few fixed steps.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.lineage: Darkroom printing records and zone ramps
options.thesis: Tone steps and hatch density carry all state.
options.viewport: Overlapping translucent sheets with hatched regions.
options.case: Too technical for a phone glance, and the student doesn't know the darkroom.
options.kept: One shared neutral ramp for both themes; conflicts as cross-hatch.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean productivity app: white cards, one blue accent, a workhorse sans.
canonCard.viewport: Status line, a card list and a tab bar, the way Todoist or Notion lay it out.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
